verdict.rationale: The evidence shows item-level sharing: the Graph createLink action creates a sharing link on a specific driveItem, and external sharing to outside parties is documented. That is a form of per-file and per-folder access grant. However, no evidence names distinct roles such as viewer, commenter, editor or owner, and nothing documents how permissions inherit down the folder hierarchy. missing for 10: documented role set (viewer/commenter/editor/owner), permission inheritance behavior, folder-vs-file permission granularity docs, admin permission management, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, permissions are granular — folder- and file-level roles (viewer/commenter/editor/owner) with inheritance behavior documented

citations.quote: The createLink action creates a new sharing link if the specified link type doesn't already exist for the calling application.
External sharing in SharePoint and OneDrive allows users to share content with people outside your organization, such as partners, vendors, clients, or customers.
